none: PAS FindID 1017832: Roman coin fragment: nummus of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin fragment. Nummus of the House of Valentinian (364-378), Victory left, Reece period 19. This coin is in much better condition than accompanying material and may have been recently disturbed from a sealed context or hoard. Just under half the flan is lost. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right, seem from the front. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: [SRCVRI]TAS [REI PVBLICAE. Diameter: 16.9mm, Weight: 1.46gms, die axis: 6
